🚨 We've solved dictation on iPhone before Apple did. 

Introducing the best iOS dictation app and an actual usable keyboard as if Apple made it.

We believe AI should run on-device and we're starting with dictation. 

Give our best on-device models a try along with a lot of cool features!

- Custom made dictation cleanup models for any iPhone from 11-18.
- Real time streaming just like Apple dictation.
- Custom modes for lists and emails.
- On-device Fluid Chat.
- Snippets, Clipboard and more.

PS:  Please turn ON airplane mode - before you compare us with any other dictation app out there.

Your voice should be yours. Not theirs.
